_readme: PROVISIONAL. What sdk/cleartext-config.json will gain when v14 is wired in (plan section 6), carried inside
v14 until then because nothing outside v14/ may change before that. Same schema as the shared JSON so the
wiring step is a merge: move `constants` and `localhost.generations` into the shared file, delete this one,
and delete the guard test in test/cleartext-config-mirror.test.ts that asserts the shared file lacks them.

CLEARTEXT_KMS_NODE_MPC_IDENTITY_PREFIX.note: v14 only: the first half of `KmsNodeParams.mpcIdentity`. Node i is `${PREFIX}${i + 1}${INFIX}${i + 1}`, so `kms-core-1-cleartext-core-1`, the shape the Sepolia devnet uses (`kms-core-1-zws-dev-core-1`) with the cluster name saying cleartext.

CLEARTEXT_KMS_NODE_MPC_IDENTITY_INFIX.note: v14 only: the second half of `KmsNodeParams.mpcIdentity`, between the two node numbers. The cluster name in the middle is what distinguishes one deployment from another; here it says there is no cluster.

CLEARTEXT_KMS_NODE_PUBLIC_STORAGE_PREFIX.note: v14 only: `KmsNodeParams.storagePrefix`, the prefix WITHIN the storage bucket where KMS Core writes public material (upstream: proto `MpcNode.public_storage_prefix`; devnet: `PUB-pN`). Node i gets `${prefix}${i + 1}`. Distinct from CLEARTEXT_KMS_NODE_STORAGE_URL_PREFIX, which is the bucket itself.

CLEARTEXT_KMS_SOFTWARE_VERSION.note: v14 only: the `softwareVersion` argument of `ProtocolConfig.initializeFromEmptyProxy` and `reinitializeV2`, naming the KMS build a context was created under (devnet: `v0.13.20`). There is no KMS build behind a cleartext stack; valid semver with a prerelease tag says exactly that, and nothing on-chain parses it.

CLEARTEXT_KMS_NODE_CA_CERT.note: v14 only: `KmsNodeParams.caCert`, the node's CA certificate as HEX (devnet: a ~768-byte PEM). Carried as a hex string because that is what viem takes for `bytes` and the only bytes-like type the config faces know; the generated LocalHostBootstrap turns it into a Solidity `bytes` constant. A cleartext stack has no MPC peer to verify, so it is empty: `0x`.

0.14.0._note: Identical to 0.13.0 on purpose: v14 deploys the same nine proxies in the same order from the same deployer, so every CREATE address is the same. Written out rather than aliased because these tables are positional and a copy diverges visibly where an alias would silently follow.
